snippet.title: Shared Beauty - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A psychological horror visual novel about a dark fairy tale. 

Download our game here for free! 
https://night-asobu.itch.io/shared-beauty 
 
Shared Beauty is a dark fairy tale about jealousy, lost friendships and aging, set in a fictional medieval German village.

Once upon a time, there was a poor village. You and your friends hope that a marriage to a noble would save it. So you use the spell of youth and beauty on one of you. All seems to be going well until you notice you’re aging faster. Will you continue to share your lifespan? Or will jealousy and desperation consume you? 

Content Warnings for the game:
Deaths and Gerascophobia (Fear of Aging). 
Player discretion is advised. 

The game was made within a month for the 5th Spooktober VN Jam:
https://itch.io/jam/spooktober-2023 
 
Follow us on twitter and tumblr! 
https://twitter.com/NightAsobu
https://www.tumblr.com/nightasobu
